scientific_integrity: Recurrence matched to the published Equation (2) at beta=1; all infinite-time claims have a self-contained mathematical proof; finite diagnostic iteration is not treated as proof.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic theorem is restricted to the beta=1 slice, strict parameter chamber and explicit positive escape wedge; no exhaustive global basin classification is proved.

Earlier continuous-time research already established qualitative predator explosion for related no-refuge models; the new claim is a specific discrete-time two-amplitude result with a simultaneously attracting prey-only state.
Unbounded population densities are a model artifact in the absence of predator crowding; no physical finite-time explosion is implied.
Unindexed or inaccessible papers could contain equivalent discrete limit formulas; no independent audit or publication-priority certification is claimed.
title: Two scattering amplitudes for predator runaway beside a stable prey-only state
